findings.description: The truthiness check skips valid callable wait strategies that evaluate to false. The same regression affects the asynchronous implementation.
findings.rationale: A custom callable wait strategy can define __len__ returning 0 or __bool__ returning False while its __call__ returns a positive delay. Previously that strategy was invoked unless it compared equal to zero; now it is skipped and upcoming_sleep becomes 0.0, causing immediate retries instead of the configured delay.
